posts.text: OpenAI's Codex, its coding agent, has a Rust struct in its own codebase named ClaudeHooksEngine, with fields handlers: Vec<ConfiguredHandler> and warnings: Vec<String>. Verified directly from codex-rs/hooks/src/engine/mod.rs on raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main. If you're building on Codex's hook system, the code underneath it is named after a rival product.
